---
title: "map-save"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


## Generate some data
```{r}
set.seed(123)
sales <- tibble(
  prod_id = c(rep("A", 3), rep("B", 3), rep("C", 4)),
  Jan = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Feb = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Mar = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Apr = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  May = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Jun = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Jul = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Aug = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Sep = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE),
  Oct = sample(100:500, 10, replace = TRUE)
)

# introduce some NAs
sales[3, "Mar"] <- NA
sales[6, "Jun"] <- NA
sales[10, "Jun"] <- NA
sales[2, "Oct"] <- NA

sales
```


## Save the sale of each product into a seperate csv file named after the product
```{r}
sales |> 
  group_by(prod_id) |> 
  group_split() |> 
  walk(\(x) {
    write_csv(x, paste(x$prod_id,".csv"))})
```
